description: Arm B: incumbent vLLM (Arm A) plus MTP speculative decoding K=1. MEASURED-WITH-DEVIATION 2026-10-18: exactly ONE deviation from Arm A flags -- --max-model-len 256608 instead of 262144 (vLLM's own estimated max from the first failed attempt). Everything else identical to Arm A (benchmarks/baseline/arm_a_live_config.json) plus --speculative-config mtp K=1, isolated container vllm-armb-qwen38-mtp on 127.0.0.1:8003 (8001 occupied by unrelated http.server). Quality 3/3 text+ids exact vs Arm A. Greedy c1: short TTFT p50 0.76-0.78s, 4272-4291 tok/min; agent-shared-prefix TTFT p50 3.33s cold / 0.90s warm, 3144-3814 tok/min (benchmarks/baseline/arm_b_mtp_k1_256608.json). Short c4: 12113-12136 tok/min (benchmarks/baseline/arm_b_mtp_k1_256608_c4.json). Spec acceptance cumulative 3574/3617 draft tokens (98.8%); after c1 benches 1014/1057 (95.9%). CAVEAT: run_bench TPOT is per streamed chunk; under MTP chunks carry multiple tokens, so TPOT p50 ~24.7ms/chunk is NOT comparable to Arm A 20.3ms/token -- effective rate is wall-clock agg tps (~71 tok/s c1 short). No like-for-like TPOT win/loss claimed from chunk TPOT.
